mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which metabolize carisoprodol to its active metabolite meprobamate, resulting in significantly reduced carisoprodol and meprobamate plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced muscle relaxant efficacy; consider alternative muscle relaxant not significantly affected by CYP450 induction, or increase carisoprodol dosing with careful clinical monitoring if no alternative available.
